findings.one_line: The bound (6) sums e_v over V once after explicitly coupling every interventional/counterfactual world; for an allowed multi-world query (e.g. E[Y(1)-Y(0)]), the Lipschitz loss is over all world-coordinate copies, so C_sieve=L_Q sum_v a_v omits their multiplicity and the stated quantitative lifting claim is false.

From finite cell masses, response intervals, and set-valued boundary routes, the reverse direction does not derive a Lipschitz/measurable selection whose actual kappa-code probabilities equal the recorded masses: (7) is asserted, not constructed. Mere measurability of kappa supplies no such realizability, so exact coded-law two-sided lifting is unproved.

This is a certificate-program-specific uniform enclosure oracle, not a primitive or derived property of the stated rational grammar; give concrete integration conditions and an enclosure construction with the claimed uniform rate, or rescope computation to an explicitly algorithmic integrable grammar.

ass:semialgebraic-code permits Boolean combinations of weak inequalities, hence negated atoms and strict cells; the proof's claims that every constraint is weak, the feasible set is closed/compact, and empty boxes are excluded by closedness do not follow. The finite-termination argument therefore needs a strict-semialgebraic treatment or a changed code partition.

cited_checks.note: The attested Basu--Pollack--Roy substrate supplies algorithmic sample points for realizable sign conditions; finite Boolean formulas reduce to finitely many sign-condition cases, and the attestation identifies the general-decision and real-univariate-representation support used here.
